items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: Benny, I’d say, “Hello Benny.” And he’d say, [grunts] “Hey.” You know.

ctx.x: Well he had a trio, he had a quartet, and he had the sextet. The trio was himself, the piano player and Gene Krupa. In the quartet he added Lionel Hampton. And in the sextet I think he added Georgie Auld on saxophone and Cootie Williams on trumpet. Anyway it went on and so forth.
Did you ever have any dealings with Benny Goodman?

No. Outside of being friendly, very dear friends with Vido Musso, who was in the band, so I would get to watch the rehearsals. Benny, I’d say, “Hello Benny.” And he’d say, [grunts] “Hey.” You know. He was very vocal — he was a grunter.
